text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: White cropped crew-neck T-shirt with pale blue small graphic, dark blue high-waisted frayed short denim shorts, black knee socks, tall dark gray folded-shaft biker boots with black straps, buckles and thick black platform soles.. Add ONLY these accessories: Bright yellow paisley cotton bandana with fine black white printed pattern, draped folded diagonally and fully visible; Black leather belt with rectangular silver buckle and silver keeper; Short chunky gold curb-chain necklace, complete closed chain; Fine gold necklace with small pendant, complete closed chain and clasp. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 4 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Bright yellow paisley cotton bandana with fine black white printed pattern, draped folded diagonally and fully visible; 2. Black leather belt with rectangular silver buckle and silver keeper; 3. Short chunky gold curb-chain necklace, complete closed chain; 4. Fine gold necklace with small pendant, complete closed chain and clasp. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
